title: Glasshouse and Silence
author: Jude Kavanagh
blurb: Ansel Galloway, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
